name: Panthaora Limited
about: Panthaora Limited engages in the provision of consultancy services in India. The company operates in two segments, Rendering of Services and Trading of Goods. It offers green energy projects consulting and contracts; biofuel supply chain solution, boiler retrofitting and management services, and steam supply contract; ESG and carbon advisory services; and battery energy storage systems and energy efficiency solutions. Panthaora Limited was formerly known as JMG Corporation Limited and changed its name to Panthaora Limited in August 2026. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in New Delhi, India.
